scholarship_title: Chalmers University of Technology Scholarships for Fee-Paying Master's Students (autumn 2027 intake)
eligible_nationalities: All countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland (tuition-fee-paying applicants)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Depends on the scholarship: past schemes include IPOET (75% tuition reduction) and Adlerbert Study Scholarships (full tuition waiver)

stipend.notes: No living costs; you must show funds for living costs for the Swedish residence permit

application_fee.notes: SEK 900 University Admissions in Sweden application fee for the programme application (cannot be waived); no separate scholarship fee stated

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Strong academic record; must meet programme admission requirements

required_documents.name: Programme application on universityadmissions.se
required_documents.detail: Application number needed for the scholarship form

preparation_alerts: The scholarship deadline is the programme deadline (15 Jan 2027), not the 1 Feb document deadline

selection_criteria.pass_rule: Award notices mid-March to late April 2027

source_urls.title: Chalmers: scholarships for fee-paying students
source_urls.used_for: Window late Nov 2026 to mid-Jan 2027; deadline matches programme deadline

source_urls.title: Chalmers: key dates for master's
source_urls.used_for: Programme application 16 Oct 2026 to 15 Jan 2027; documents 1 Feb; notices

verification_status.verification_notes: Official pages (via search results) give a scholarship window from late November 2026 to mid-January 2027; exact opening date not stated, so status unknown. Which schemes run in 2027 (IPOET, Adlerbert) was not confirmed; their pages refer to 2023.
